story.title: Dadi ke haathon ki karigari
story.lead: Ek chhote se gaon Fatehpur, Uttar Pradesh se shuru hui ek kahani — jahan dhaage sirf buney nahi jaate, rishton mein badal jaate hain.
story.body: Yahan ki dadiyaan jaanti hain ki haathon ki bunai sirf ek kaam nahi, ek parampara hai. Thandiyaan ho ya garmi, apne parivaar ke liye, apne naati-poton ke liye, woh waqt ko ungliyon ke jaadu se khoobsurat bana deti thi. Crochella usi ehsaas ko aaj ke rozmarra mein lekar aati hai.
